value.note: The long gallery's bay-1 lantern swapped for a soul lantern.

why: The lantern hung in the long gallery's bay 1 — the bay the loop lands a body in — swapped by a world edit for a soul lantern, every other bay's left as it was. From the landing the soul lantern hangs in sight; from the slab, its counterpart in bay 2 is a lantern, so the two views differ by a lamp. The refusal names the cell and both block states. A swap rather than the deletion spec-0086 §9 names: this hall declares `lighting.min_light`, so the relight pass hangs a deleted lantern straight back at the cell it left, and the world as shipped tiles again — the deletion is a defect the engine repairs, not one it refuses. It declares no unit.
